questions.question: What does Psalm 66 call all the earth to do?
options: Weep aloud and mourn over the many sins of the land
Shout for joy to God and sing the glory of his name
Bow down in deep silence and wait upon the LORD
Bring forward your offerings and faithfully pay your vows
questions.answer: Shout for joy to God and sing the glory of his name

questions.question: What past deed does the psalm recall?
options: Bringing fresh water out from the hard rock in the dry desert
Turning the sea into dry land so they passed through on foot
Casting down to the ground the walls of the great city
Sending down manna from heaven to feed the hungry people
questions.answer: Turning the sea into dry land so they passed through on foot

questions.question: The psalmist says if he had cherished iniquity in his heart, the Lord would not have listened.
Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward _____.
